> Clean by construction: the action-item half of a post-mortem.

Three actions, each with an owner and a date.

Raise the database connection limit to match the application pool, this week,
owned by the platform team. Add a check that fails the deploy when the two
numbers disagree, next sprint, same owner. Rewrite the runbook section on
queue backlogs, this week, owned by whoever was on call — that is the person
who found out what the current text is missing.

No action here is "be more careful". If an action cannot be assigned a date it
is not an action.
